free_tier.stated: Local VMs are free forever with no account needed and unlimited VMs limited only by the machine; the hosted sandbox has no free allowance, is billed per second only while running, and adding a card tops up EUR 20 of credit when the balance is empty, with automatic top-ups of EUR 20 at a time.
free_tier.notes: The free offer is software the user installs and runs locally: 'Run sandboxes as VMs on your own machine. No account needed.' The hosted cloud lane has no free tier; credit requires a card.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a running sandbox, not an object; a hosted sandbox disk grows up to 200 GiB, and up to 50 GiB for a confidential sandbox
per_object_cap.notes: The cap is on the disk of one sandbox, not on an object.

retention.stated: A stopped sandbox keeps its disk, settings and agent conversations and is not billed; a sandbox whose time to live ends is removed unless protected; credits do not expire.

egress.terms: A hosted sandbox may reach the public Internet; private, loopback, link-local and carrier-grade NAT ranges are excluded. Organization network policies are stored but not enforced yet, and a hosted sandbox can still reach anything public whatever it selects. No egress price or allowance is published.

interface_detail: The cw CLI, SSH, scp, sftp, rsync and VS Code over an encrypted tunnel, a browser dashboard terminal, HTTPS preview URLs for published ports, and an HTTP API for organizations.
tooling: the cw CLI installed with 'curl -fsSL https://get.codewire.sh | sh'; SSH, scp, sftp and rsync; VS Code; a browser dashboard; an HTTP API; Docker inside every VM; Claude Code and Codex integrated by default
chaining: A hosted sandbox with a per-second meter and HTTPS preview URLs chains into a build or agent workflow, and a stopped sandbox keeps its disk; a job that must survive removal needs a separate object-storage record.

limits.value: EUR 0.0438 per vCPU-hour, EUR 0.0141 per GB-hour of memory, EUR 0.000087 per GB-hour of disk, billed per second; a default 2 vCPU and 8 GB sandbox costs EUR 0.2091 per hour
10 creates and 10 starts per minute, per person
32 vCPU and 64 GiB of memory across active sandboxes; 10 sandboxes included in the cloud plan

limits_note: A sandbox can have up to 16 vCPU, 32 GB of memory and 200 GB of disk on the calculator; the resources page permits up to 256 vCPU and 1 TiB of memory on a hosted sandbox. Disks only grow. Without a card, or if a top-up fails, new sandboxes and starts are refused at once, and running sandboxes stop after 24 hours. Human developer seats are USD 18 per developer per month; agents are not seats.
binding_note: The hosted lane has no free allowance and draws metered credit per second, so the card-funded balance runs out before any request or sandbox-count limit is reached.

identity_cost.detail: The signup form asks for Name, Email, Password of at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, a number and a symbol, a Confirm password field, an optional invite code, and 'What would you like to build?' for review. A hosted sandbox needs an organization; adding a card tops up EUR 20 of credit. The local VM path needs no account. No phone number, ID document or institution is asked for on the signup page.

reliability_note: The provider states Codewire is pre-1.0 and breaking changes can land between releases. Without a card, or if a top-up fails, new sandboxes and starts are refused at once and running sandboxes stop after 24 hours; their storage is kept. Hosted network policies are stored but not enforced yet.
confidence_note: The per-second rates, the EUR 20 card top-up, the 24-hour stop, the signup fields, the egress terms and the organization limits are quoted from Codewire's own pricing, signup and documentation pages read on 2026-11-24.
